question: A can do a piece of work in 24 days and B can do it in 80 days. B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day. This process continues till the work is completed. In how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:** 

A = 24 days 

B = 80 days

B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day 

**Formula Used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

A = 24 days

B = 80 days

B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day.

Work completed in 3 days = 2× (1)/(80)+(1)/(24)

Work completed in 3 days = (1)/(40)+(1)/(24)=(3+5)/(120)=(8)/(120)=(1)/(15)

Work completed in 3 days = 15 units 

Total work is completed in = 3× 15=45 days

 

**∴ the whole work is completed in 45 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** **Time Work Efficiency 

⇒ A 24 240 10 

⇒ B 80 240 3 

B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day

work done in 3 days = 3 + 3 + 10 = 16

⇒ T = 240/16

⇒ T = 15 times

⇒ T = 15 × 3

⇒ T = 45 days 

**∴ The time taken to complete the task is 45 days.**
